description: A closed hand with its thumb extended straight down beneath it. Stacked rounded finger knuckles line the right edge, and the broad back of the hand forms a rounded block across the top.
A three-step winner's podium with a tall central block flanked by two lower blocks of equal height, all with rounded corners. The numeral 1 stands in the upper part of the central block.

Three upright figures stand in a row at different heights: circle-headed figures on short rounded bodies at the left and lower right, and a tall rounded centre block with a five-pointed star floating above it in place of a head.
A three-step podium of square-cornered blocks: a tall centre block, a medium block on the left and the lowest block on the right. The numeral 1 sits near the top of the centre block.
Three identical five-pointed stars sit side by side in a horizontal row, their outer points touching their neighbours. Each star has a small star-shaped opening at its centre.
